core_statement: These systems are not competitors on one compression axis. They remove waste from different operational surfaces.

entries.combination_position: may precede output/handoff and V13 governance
may coexist with instruction and output reduction
may feed output/handoff and V13 governance
may sit downstream of other reductions
entries.proposed_removal_boundary: repetitive or non-actionable output and handoff material

entries.combination_position: may govern compatible combinations across surfaces
entries.preserved_boundary: human Seat, evidence, rollback, and re-entry capacity
entries.proposed_removal_boundary: unnecessary or unauthorized repeated loops and ambiguous authority transitions

rules: Higher percentage does not imply cross-layer superiority.
Combinations are allowed only when preserved boundaries remain compatible.
No external performance number is included.
Cross-layer ranking and superiority claims are prohibited.
